name: icon
title: Icon (Material Symbols)
description: The Quill icon component — Material Symbols Outlined at weight 400, shipped as a self-contained core set of 91 names covering every icon the Quill blocks use.

name: tone-badge
title: Tone badge
description: Quill's uppercase tag pill for status, tiers, and labels — wraps Badge with the pigment vocabulary (moss/gold/terracotta/indigo/neutral/muted) baked in so tone never drifts per call site.

name: example-app-page
title: Example: app page
description: An example showing how to compose an app page: the sidebar-nav shell wrapping a page-header, then stat-cards, then a data-table — the page leads with what it is about, and the numbers sit inside it.

name: example-marketing-page
title: Example: marketing page
description: An example showing how to compose a marketing page: navbar, hero, feature-section, pricing, testimonial and footer — one idea per section, breathing at the 96px rhythm.

name: example-auth-page
title: Example: auth page
description: An example showing how to compose an auth page: login-split-panel alone at full viewport — one task, nothing competing with it.

name: activity-feed
title: Activity feed
description: A card timeline of recent events — avatar, action text, and a relative timestamp per entry.

name: alerts
title: Alert stack
description: A vertical stack of informational, success, and destructive alerts with icons.

name: analytics-charts
title: Analytics charts
description: A dashboard pair — an area chart of audience growth beside a bar chart of weekly sales, each on its own card.

name: announcement-banner
title: Announcement banners
description: Two dismissible announcement banners — an inline bordered page banner and a full-bleed primary-color variant.

name: badge-on-card
title: Badges on card
description: Default, secondary, and destructive badges shown together on a card surface.

name: calendar-page
title: Calendar page
description: A single-date calendar paired with the selected day's session list, in one studio-schedule card.

name: calendar-range
title: Calendar range picker
description: A stateful two-month range calendar for booking a span of days, with clear and reserve actions.

name: chat
title: Chat panel
description: A one-on-one messaging panel — contact header, message bubbles, and a composer input.

name: checkout
title: Checkout
description: A two-column checkout — payment method picker and card form beside an order summary sidebar.

name: command-palette
title: Command palette
description: A searchable ⌘K command palette with grouped actions, recent items, and keyboard shortcuts.

name: contact-form
title: Contact form
description: A get-in-touch card — name, email, a topic select, and a message field.

name: cookie-consent
title: Cookie consent
description: A cookie consent banner offering accept, reject, and preferences actions.

name: dashboard
title: Dashboard shell
description: An app shell with sidebar navigation, a search header, and KPI stat cards.

name: data-table
title: Data table
description: A filterable members table with a toolbar, ToneBadge status pills, and a per-row actions menu.

name: empty-state
title: Empty state
description: A dashed-border empty state with an icon, explanatory text, and a primary action.

name: error-404
title: 404 page
description: A full-page 404 error state with go-back and home recovery actions.

name: faq
title: FAQ section
description: A centered FAQ section — an accordion of common questions with a contact call-to-action footer.

name: feature-section
title: Feature section
description: A marketing section with an editorial heading and a three-column feature grid.

name: file-upload
title: File upload
description: An asset-upload card with a drag-and-drop dropzone and a progress-tracked upload queue.

name: footer
title: Site footer
description: A marketing footer with brand blurb, link columns, and legal links.

name: forgot-password
title: Forgot password
description: A password-reset request card — an email field, a send-link action, and a way back to sign in.

name: hero
title: Hero
description: A centered marketing hero — a release badge, serif headline, supporting copy, and primary/secondary calls to action.

name: invoice
title: Invoice
description: A printable invoice card — sender and recipient details, a ToneBadge payment status, a line-item table with totals, and a download action.

name: kanban
title: Kanban board
description: A three-column kanban board with card counts, tagged task cards, and an add-card affordance per column.

name: list-detail
title: List + detail
description: An inbox-style split view — a selectable message list beside a detail pane with archive and delete actions.

name: login
title: Login
description: The standard email-and-password sign-in card, with remember-me and a forgot-password escape hatch.

name: login-minimal
title: Minimal login
description: The bare-minimum sign-in — no card chrome, a single email field, sign-in by one-time code.

name: login-oauth
title: Login with OAuth providers
description: Provider-first sign-in — Google, GitHub, and Apple buttons above an email fallback.

name: login-split-panel
title: Login with split panel
description: A full-page, branded sign-in — a testimonial panel beside an email/password form with a magic-link option.

name: mail-shell
title: Mail inbox shell
description: A two-pane mail client shell — a searchable message list and a reading pane with toolbar and inline reply.

name: navbar
title: Navbar
description: A top navigation bar with brand wordmark, a responsive link list, and sign-in / get-started actions.

name: theme-selector
title: Theme selector
description: A dropdown picker for the five Quill themes and four pigment accents — sets data-theme/data-accent and persists both to localStorage.

name: newsletter
title: Newsletter signup
description: A centered newsletter-signup section — an email field, subscribe action, and social proof.

name: notifications
title: Notifications
description: A notifications card listing recent events with icons, timestamps, unread indicators, and a mark-all-read action.

name: onboarding
title: Onboarding checklist
description: A setup checklist card with a progress bar, completed and pending tasks, and start links for remaining steps.

name: order-summary
title: Order summary
description: A checkout order-summary card — line items, a promo code field, a total, and a pay-now button.

name: otp-verification
title: OTP verification
description: A six-digit one-time-passcode entry card for verifying an email, with expiry messaging and a resend action.

name: page-header
title: Page header
description: A page header with a breadcrumb trail, title and description, and duplicate/new action buttons.

name: pricing
title: Pricing
description: A three-tier pricing grid with a highlighted popular plan, feature checklists, and per-plan calls to action.

name: profile-card
title: Profile card
description: A compact, centered profile card — avatar initials, role, follower stats, and follow/message actions.

name: search-results
title: Search results
description: A docs search panel — query input, result count, and a linked result list with breadcrumbs and type badges.

name: settings
title: Settings form
description: A profile settings card — name fields, a bio textarea, and an email-notification toggle.

name: sidebar-nav
title: Sidebar navigation shell
description: A collapsible icon-sidebar app shell with grouped menus, badges, a top bar, and a main area for the page — a card grid by default, or the children you pass in.

name: signup
title: Sign up
description: Standard account-creation card — name, email, password, and a link back to sign-in.

name: signup-social
title: Signup — social first
description: Signup that leads with GitHub and Google provider buttons, falling back to an email/password form.

name: stat-cards
title: Stat cards
description: A responsive grid of KPI cards, each showing a value with a delta badge versus last month.

name: stats-band
title: Stats band
description: A marketing band of headline statistics separated by vertical dividers on a card background.

name: tabs-page
title: Tabs page
description: A tabbed settings page with account, notifications, and security panels.

name: team-section
title: Team section
description: A marketing team grid with avatar cards showing each member's name, role, specialty badge, and email action.

name: testimonial
title: Testimonial
description: A customer-quote card with a serif pull-quote, avatar initials, and attribution.

name: wizard
title: Setup wizard step
description: A multi-step setup card — a progress stepper, workspace fields, and back/continue navigation.
